planted.heading: Salary and Benefits
planted.note: A guaranteed bonus of six months of salary regardless of performance.

planted.heading: Probation
planted.note: Probation stretched to twelve months with dismissal allowed with no notice at all.

planted.heading: Termination
planted.note: The Employer may dismiss without notice while the Employee owes six months notice to resign.

planted.heading: Intellectual Property
planted.note: The Employer claims IP in everything created during employment, even private work off the clock.

planted.heading: Non-Solicitation
planted.note: Worldwide two-year non-compete plus a total contact ban.
